summary: Single MEDIUM finding addressed inline. Module structure, error handling, and contract adherence are clean.

findings.title: _PROMPT_CACHE keyed only by mtime — potential stale-cache bug across path fallback
findings.description: Original cache shape was {'mtime': ..., 'body': ...}. If a caller invokes _load_prompt(path_A), then _load_prompt(path_B) where mtime values happen to coincide, the second call returns path_A's cached body. Realistic scenario: subdir-path miss → flat-fallback hit on the same file system tree. Cache must be keyed by (path, mtime).
findings.resolution: Extended _PROMPT_CACHE to {'path': ..., 'mtime': ..., 'body': ...}. Test fixture updated to match. All 15 tests still green.

findings.title: _classify_exception fall-through returns raw exc
findings.description: If a non-anthropic.APIError exception escapes the SDK call (e.g. a user-injected mock that side_effects ValueError), _classify_exception returns the raw exc and the caller sees an unwrapped error. The catch-block in transcreate_via_claude only catches anthropic.APIError; anything else bubbles up to the caller.
findings.resolution: Documented behaviour matches Decision 5 intent (only SDK errors are classified; truly unexpected errors should surface, not be silently re-typed). No change.

findings.title: _parse_response does not validate per-block shape (only length)
findings.description: Tech-spec asks 'blocks array must mirror its length and types'. Current implementation validates length only, not per-element type. Acceptable for now — block usage is autoevolution-only, type validation can be added in a follow-up if observed misbehaviour.
findings.resolution: No change. Length check covers the common drift mode (model dropping or duplicating blocks).
